findings_addressed.oracle: BitsAndBytesConfig() constructor contract: load_in_8bit and load_in_4bit both default to False. These are independent of the production code branch under test.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/model_loader.py line 821, change 'return BitsAndBytesConfig()' to 'return BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_8bit=True)' — the assertion 'getattr(config, "load_in_8bit", True) is False' immediately fails.

notes: Hardened the weak existence/type-only check (N8) by adding two concrete attribute assertions: load_in_8bit is False and load_in_4bit is False. These attributes distinguish the default BitsAndBytesConfig() from the int8 and int4 branches. The oracle is the documented constructor default, independent of the production code path. If the production code mistakenly returned an int8 or int4 config for a float16 input, at least one assertion would fail.
